description: Privacy oriented video player for iOS, tvOS and macOS

latest_release.name: v1.5.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

* support for private instances by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/565
* honour the aspect ratio when resizing by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/562
* make links in description clickable by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/560
* make description collapsible by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/559
* macOS: disable hit testing when not expanded by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/578
* disable portraitUpsideDown on iPhones by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/569
* make chapters collapsible and highlight current chapter by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/564
* more robust regex for chapters from description by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/597
* Translations update from Weblate
* Added Persian, Spanish, Turkish and Russian localizations
* Other changes and improvements
## New Contributors
* @stonerl made their first contribution in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/565

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yattee/yattee/compare/v1.5...v1.5.1

detail.readme:
Yattee

Privacy oriented video player for iOS, tvOS and macOS

[![AGPL v3](https://shields.io/badge/License-AGPL%20v3-blue.svg)](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.en.html) [![GitHub issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/yattee/yattee)](https://github.com/yattee/yattee/issues) [![GitHub pull requests](https://img.shields.io/github/issues-pr/yattee/yattee)](https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pulls) [![Discord](https://invidget.switchblade.xyz/pSnNKhZHEG)](https://yattee.stream/discord)
> **Yattee 2 is in the works!** A new version of the app is being built with a refreshed experience. > It pairs with the new [Yattee Server](https://github.com/yattee/yattee-server) — a self-hosted backend powered by yt-dlp that supports 1000+ sites. > Join the [TestFlight beta](https://yattee.stream/beta2) to try early builds, and check the new documentation site at [docs.yattee.stream](https://docs.yattee.stream) for guides, roadmap and changelog. ## Features * Native user interface built with [SwiftUI](https://developer.apple.com/swiftui/) with customization settings * Player queue and history * Player component with custom controls, gestures and support for 4K playback * Fullscreen, Picture in Picture and background audio playback * [SponsorBlock](https://sponsor.ajay.app/), configurable categories to skip * [Automation](https://docs.yattee.stream/docs/app/automation) with the `yattee://` URL scheme, x-callback-url, Shortcuts and Siri ## License Yattee and its components is shared on [AGPL v3](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.en.html) license.
